props.gloss_en: R' Yehuda: the beams were a cubit thick at the bottom and narrowed to a fingerbreadth at the top
R' Nechemya: just as they were a cubit thick at the bottom, so at the top
'and the middle bar in the midst of the beams' -- it stood by a miracle
laying the lower curtains' length (28) across the Mishkan's width, less ten for the roof, nine remain on this side and nine on that
for R' Yehuda, the cubit of the sockets is exposed
for R' Nechemya, the cubit of the beams is exposed
laying their width (40) along the Mishkan's length, less thirty for the roof, ten remain
for R' Yehuda, the cubit of the sockets is covered
for R' Nechemya, the cubit of the sockets is exposed
the goat-hair curtains' length (30) across the width, less ten for the roof: ten remain on each side
for R' Yehuda, the cubit of the sockets is covered
for R' Nechemya, the cubit of the sockets is exposed
'and the cubit on this side and the cubit on that side of the overhang' (Ex 26:13) -- to cover the cubit of the sockets: R' Yehuda
R' Nechemya: to cover the cubit of the beams
the goat-hair curtains' width (44) along the length, less thirty for the roof, fourteen remain; less two for the doubling, twelve remain
subtract two for the doubling, as it is written: 'and you shall double the sixth curtain over the front of the tent' (Ex 26:9)
granted for R' Yehuda: that is what is written, 'the half curtain that remains shall trail' (Ex 26:12)
for R' Nechemya, 'shall trail' means it trails beyond its fellows
to what is the Mishkan like? to a woman walking in the marketplace with her skirts trailing after her
the beams were grooved and the sockets hollow
and the clasps in the loops looked like stars in the sky
the lower curtains were of blue, purple, scarlet and linen, and the upper of goat hair

greater wisdom is stated of the upper curtains than of the lower: of the lower it is written 'every wise-hearted woman spun with her hands', of the upper 'all the women whose hearts lifted them in wisdom spun the goats'
[the hair] was rinsed on the goats and spun from the goats

supports.gloss_en: תניא נמי הכי: for R' Yehuda the goat-hair curtains' overhang (Ex 26:13) goes to cover the sockets' cubit, as the stam computed at 98b.8
תניא נמי הכי: for R' Nechemya the overhang goes to cover the beams' cubit, so the sockets' cubit stays exposed, as the stam computed at 98b.8

objections.gloss_en: אלא לרבי נחמיה מאי תסרח? -- if the overhang goes to cover the beams' cubit, what is the trailing the verse speaks of?

answered_by.gloss_en: תסרח מחברותיה -- it trails beyond its fellow curtains (= p_rn_tisrach_mechavroteha)
